entries.content: Giá cà phê: 89.000đ cho gói 250g, 179.000đ cho gói 500g, 359.000đ cho gói 1kg.
Nguồn gốc hạt: Robusta Đức Cơ (Gia Lai).
Hạt điều: 99.000đ (hộp nhỏ), 199.000đ, 379.000đ theo quy cách trên trang shop. Lưu ý: blog cũ ghi 94.000đ/169.000đ/339.000đ — mâu thuẫn với shop, chưa được xác minh lại.

note: Per-brand fact base built ONLY from facts verified in calibration/caonguyenmoc-report.md (shop prices read live 21 Nov 2026). No delivery_days and no roast_weekday: the calibration never verified a delivery range or a roast weekday for this brand, so those checks are skipped for it rather than judged against another brand's facts. The blog's own cashew prices (94/169/339k) contradict the shop's (99/199/379k) in the report, so the shop prices are the known ones and the blog numbers still flag — legitimately.
